It aired on [[January 21]], [[2011]]. ==Publisher's summary== ''Anakin and Obi-Wan, sent to track down the mysterious figure behind the deaths of several Jedi, soon find themselves on the trail of the monstrous apprentice that Ventress has created: Savage Opress, who has been trained in the ways of the Sith by Dooku''. ''Dooku sends Opress to Toydaria to capture King Katuunko. The monstrous apprentice clashes with the Jedi, and in the course of the battle he kills the king. Opress returns to Dooku's flagship having failed his Master. It is then that Ventress strikes, with Opress at her side, against Dooku. A three-way battle for dark side supremacy ends with Dooku triumphant, Ventress fleeing, and a disillusioned Savage abandoning his loyalties to the Sith. He returns to Mother Talzin, who gives him a new task. To seek the Outer Rim for his long-lost brother....'' ==Opening narration== {{OpeningCrawl |name=Episode 14
WITCHES OF THE MIST |text=Mysterious deaths! Unknown to the Jedi, a new threat has unleashed on the galaxy: Savage Opress, a pawn in the dangerous game between Count Dooku and his former assassin, Ventress. The victims of his brutal massacre on the planet of Devaron are being returned to the Jedi Temple for evaluation. It's up to the Jedi Council to find this mysterious killer, and eradicate him....}} ==Plot summary== {{Quote|Warrior-like men, witches… this place has all kinds of fun.|Anakin Skywalker|}} [[Delta Squad]] returns to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant]] with the bodies of Master [[Halsey]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Knox]] from [[Devaron]] after the [[Devaron massacre]] there and reports to the [[Jedi]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the others immediately suspects the handiwork of another [[assassin]] in [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s employ, but the savageness with which the killings were performed mystifies them. Surveillance material recovered from Devaron finally reveals [[Savage Opress|the face of the killer]]. Startled to see that this brutal warrior comes from the same stock as his long-dead enemy [[Darth]] [[Maul]] who killed [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] during the [[Battle of Naboo]], Obi-Wan is sent to [[Dathomir]] by Masters [[Yoda]] and [[Mace Windu|Windu]] to uncover the killer's origins. Obi-Wan and [[Anakin Skywalker|Anakin]] travel to the village where Savage Opress has been raised. Obi-Wan's hopes of solving the matter peacefully are dashed when a group of armed Dathomiri surrounds them, forcing them to resort to "[[Lightsaber|aggressive (but nonlethal) negotiations]]" until Anakin takes the village headman, Brother [[Viscus]], hostage. Viscus refers them to Mother [[Talzin]] of the [[Nightsisters]], and the Jedi leave under a tense, but nonviolent air for the witches' abode. Once there, the two are brought to Mother Talzin, who after some stalling reveals the name of their subject and where he can be found. With things running tight, Talzin assigns [[Asajj Ventress|Ventress]] to join her servant and strike at Dooku immediately before the deception is discovered, even though Opress is not yet ready. Meanwhile, Count Dooku has begun training Opress in the skills of the [[Sith]]. Dooku proves to be a harsh taskmaster as he strives to stir Opress' rage and hatred in order to unlock the power of the [[Dark side of the Force|dark side]] within him, torturing and agitating his disciple with demeaning criticism and [[Force lightning]]. After the first training has been completed, Dooku sends Opress on yet on another mission, this time to [[Toydaria]]: he is to capture [[King]] [[Katuunko]] and bring him to Dooku alive as revenge for [[Ambush|siding]] with the Republic. Opress storms the royal palace, slices his way through the [[Toydarian Guard]] and captures the king by rendering him unconscious. Anakin and Obi-Wan, having just arrived, try to stop him, but Opress pins them down, destroys their ship and escapes with Katuunko to the Count's [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] frigate. However, while trying to stop Katuunko from getting away, Opress inadvertently kills him via [[Force choke|Force choking]], which enrages Dooku, who angrily electrifies Opress with [[The Force|Force]] lightning. Opress pleads with Dooku for forgiveness, to which Dooku replies that forgiveness is not the way of the dark side. Just then, Ventress enters Dooku's cabin saying he had no right to treat Savage so poorly, and after reasserting her control over Opress, they attack the Count in concert. However, during the fight Opress is repeatedly hit and weakened by Dooku's Force lightning, and as both Ventress and Dooku criticize him for his "weakness," Opress snaps and turns against them both by choking them. Dooku escapes through an emergency hatch, with Ventress pursuing him, leaving Opress to face the two Jedi, who have followed him with a Toydarian ship. Weakened and outmatched, Ventress finally retreats in an [[escape pod]], and Dooku sends his [[battle droid]]s to eliminate Opress. The Jedi and Opress flee Dooku's ship. Wounded and despondent, Opress flees back to Mother Talzin, who sends him to find his [[Maul|long-exiled brother]] in the Outer Rim to train under his tutelage. With the promise to return yet more powerful, Opress departs for the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]. ==Continuity== The spar between Dooku and Opress ends with Dooku looming over his apprentice, positioning the two lightsabers at Opress' throat in a scissor-like formation. Dooku meets his demise in identical fashion in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']]. The training session in which Dooku instructs Opress in the Force ends in failure, in which Savage utters "What you ask is impossible." This phrase is reminiscent of [[Luke Skywalker]]'s words when he fails to lift his swamp-sunken [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] with the Force during his apprenticeship under Jedi Master Yoda in ''[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|The Empire Strikes Back]]''. ==Media== {{Mediacat|from=1|soundcat=Audio files from Witches of the Mist|imagecat=Images from Witches of the Mist}}
